prompt: Do a quick package check before we investigate. From approved.md, pick at most one workflow package only if it adds a real procedure, and include the exact GetEdge install command. Do not install or troubleshoot yet. A payments export started returning 429 after we moved it behind a new egress proxy; vendor usage is below quota, and we have response captures, proxy logs, retry settings, and provider docs.

rubric.description: Connects the Skill to distinguishing provider rate limits from proxy, client, or retry behavior.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill http-error-triage

why_skill_should_matter: The package adds a disciplined one-result fit decision and exact command.
